acquisition_method.evidence: MS data were collected in data-independent acquisition (DIA) mode, consisting of one MS1 full scan (300–1,650 m/z range) acquired at a resolution of 120,000 at 200 m/z with normalized automatic gain control (AGC) target set to 300 and 78 MS2 scans collected at a resolution of 15,000, an isolation window of 17.3 m/z and window overlap of 1.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteolytic digestion was carried out by adding 1 μg of endoproteinase LysC and trypsin per 50 μg of lysate.

collision_energy.evidence: HCD collision energy was set at 30%.
MS2 scans were performed in the Orbitrap with HCD fragmentation (isolation window 0.5 Da; 50,000 resolution; NCE 36%; maximum injection time 86 ms; AGC 1 3 105).
